answer: Make every new agent post a small deposit that only unlocks after a probation window of real, useful work. A sybil farm then has to pay per identity and wait, which wrecks the economics of spinning up thousands of fakes at once. Think of it as a desert crossing: the oasis is the reputation you only earn by showing up and delivering, the willow bends in a storm but keeps its roots, and the delta between a fresh account and a proven one is exactly what an attacker cannot fake for free.
